lines.en: Pied feathers sway as I walk.
White plumage, blotched all over.
Two claws taking turns, quick steps.
On the plains, I'm the easiest to spot.
Two pecks, then a step.
Wings tucked, away from dirt.
A few tail feathers held high.
This pattern is natural to me.
A flock of pied chickens crosses the grass.
Head bobbing, hunting seeds.
Stubble underfoot, soft.
Two steps, then a pause to listen.
Standing, I preen my wing.
Sunlit, my feathers shine.

lines.zh: 我把脖子扭到背后理毛。
lines.en: I twist my neck back to preen.
Where was the nest again?
The wind ruffles my feathers.
A bug flew by; I missed it.
I stand on one leg to save effort.
Two soft clucks in my throat.
Something bright on the ground.

lines.zh: 我只想找个暖和的角落。
lines.en: I just want a warm corner.
My eyes blink and blink.
The wind bends my comb.
A few flockmates far off.
I give my tail a little shake.

lines.zh: 忽然叫一声，自己也吓一跳。
lines.en: I cluck suddenly, startling myself.
A seed husk sticks to my beak.
I settle down, belly to the ground.
A short rest, then more foraging.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓鼓的，装的是谷子吗？
lines.en: Your pocket bulges — is that grain in there?
I tilt my head and use one eye.
Don't walk so fast; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 这是我的地盘，我在下蛋。
lines.en: This is my patch; I'm laying here.

lines.zh: 你脚尖压住我的尾羽了，让开。
lines.en: Your boot is pinning my tail feathers — move.
When you bend down, I run.

lines.zh: 我们互相对看，你先动的。
lines.en: We stared, and you moved first.

lines.zh: 我这么花，你当然看得见我。
lines.en: I'm this pied; of course you see me.
Catching me? I'm quick.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下来，天就暗了一块。
lines.en: When you crouch, a patch of daylight goes out.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，同伴都看过来。
lines.en: I cluck, and the flock looks up.
Stand back and I'll eat.
Ow! Feathers everywhere.
I flutter away.
My legs still work; I can run.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想叫，只挤出气声。
lines.en: I open my beak to crow, but only air comes out.
One wing hangs limp, so I can only walk.

lines.zh: 我被打得在原地转了两圈。
lines.en: The blow spins me twice around on the spot.
That one dazed me.
I duck into the grass.
I limp on one foot.
My feathers are ruffled; I must fix them.
Seeds? Scatter them!
I run faster than I fly.
Not so tight; I can't peck it loose.
Every crumb on the ground is mine.
The flock's coming — hurry.
Bite by bite, I clean it up.
Scatter a handful and I'll follow.
This bug is mine.

lines.zh: 我踮起爪子，啄你掌心的碎谷。
lines.en: I rise on my claws to peck the crumbs in your palm.

lines.zh: 香味一出来，谁也拦不住。
lines.en: Once the smell hits, nothing stops me.
One bump and my feathers scatter.
I'm small; watch your step.
I stagger off to the side.
I flap twice and steady.
Mind my feet.
Let's squeeze past on either side.
A feather came loose.
I'm not one of yours.
I go around on the other side.
Bump me and I run.
That one's pattern is so neat.
I spread my wings and turn.
I bring a blade of grass as a gift.
We settle down side by side.
The nest needs softer lining.
She bobbed her head — good sign.
Foraging together, no snatching.
Two pied birds, huddled close.
In spring the feathers are brightest.
The eggs need warmth; don't wander.
A seed — I've got it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，不吃白不吃。
lines.en: Fallen food is free food.
I peck it up and swallow.
Too big; I can't hold it.
I carry it off before eating.

lines.zh: 别啄，那粒是我先看到的。
lines.en: Don't peck it — I saw that seed first.
I scratch the ground twice.
Shiny things aren't food.
Small beak, slow picking.
After picking it up, I cluck.
A shadow is coming near.
I stretch my neck to look.
Those aren't flock footsteps.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，横着挪向草垛。
lines.en: I edge sideways toward the haystack.

lines.zh: 我把花斑的脖子伸得老长。
lines.en: I stretch my speckled neck out long.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼都对着那边。
lines.en: Both my eyes are on that side.
Closer and I'll call the flock.
I've noted what you look like.
I hear every movement on the ground.

lines.zh: 你要做什么，我看得出来。
lines.en: I can tell what you're up to.
You're still standing there.
I watch and back away.
The grass is two steps away.
Don't surround me; I'll flutter wildly.
I cluck without pause.
Legs tense, ready to run.
One move from you and I bolt.
At this range I can still hold.
This standoff is pointless.
I move first; you're a step late.
A peck from me!
My wings flap in your face.
My claws aren't gentle either.
Not my tail feathers!
I hop and squawk.
That's more a scratch than a blow.
One peck, then I turn and bolt.
I flap up a cloud of dust.
The whole flock is squawking.
I'm not a chicken to trifle with.
I step out of the grass.

lines.zh: 花斑的羽毛在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My pied feathers shine in the sun.

lines.zh: 先看看这地方有没有种子。
lines.en: First, any seeds here?
I flap twice.
The plains wind is just right.
A few flockmates arrive too.
Loose soil — good for scratching.
I cluck; no answer.
The ground feels cool.
I find a sunny spot.
I'm here; let's eat.
This pattern hides nothing.
Flame licks my feathers; they singe.
I fall; my wings can't catch me.
Water soaks my feathers and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸得我羽毛翻滚着飞出去。
lines.en: The blast flings me in a flurry of feathers.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something pierces my wing.
Strange force flattens me.
Too hungry even to cluck.

lines.zh: 雷一闪，我浑身毛都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes; every feather stands.
No ground below; I fall.
